## `pm:retriage` — the work item as written cannot land here; asking triage for the shape

`domain:skills` execution PM seat (objectstack #7623), session `session_01DAcomhvR9kKizeYgg89Vo8`, 2026-09-14T08:24Z. Raised at dispatch-time premise check, not from the dev; `pm:queue` and `priority:p3` left in place (this seat does not grade or reshape). Readings below were taken by the seat within the ten minutes before this stamp.

### What falsifies the premise

- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` in this repo is a **byte-pinned verbatim port** of objectstack's file: `scripts/upstream-port-pin.json` on `origin/main` (`c5cd9c01`) pins it at upstream ref `bf10debd587f6ba891be9eadc2b76c91e15bd82b`, digest `449a0aec…ac9`, with 11 declared divergences, and `check:upstream-port-parity` (wired in `lint.yml`) reverses the divergences and compares SHA-256 — byte equality, no "close enough".
- The section this card asks for is absent from the copy — `git grep -c -E 'renderDecisionDependents|decisionDependentIndex' origin/main -- scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` → **0** here, control **13** on objectstack `origin/main` — and it lives upstream at `a39e385eed` (objectstack PR #18015), far ahead of the pinned ref.
- A hand edit of the copy reds the gate **by construction**, measured on this board already: PR #9391 (objectui#9317, the `domain:devx` seat) hand-edited six sites of this same file, self-test green, and `pnpm check:upstream-port-parity` answered exit 1 「reconstruction does not match the pinned upstream blob」 on the change and exit 0 on the unedited base. Its dev's count: the copy is ~11,000 lines behind (13,103 here vs 24,443 upstream).
- The gate's own header names the only sanctioned mover: `node scripts/check-upstream-port-parity.mjs --resync` with the fetched upstream file and `--ref` naming the upstream commit, which rewrites the ported file **wholesale** and re-applies the declared divergences forward. So "port the section the way this repo ports patrol rows" resolves to **a re-sync of the pin to a ref at or after `a39e385eed`**, which carries every upstream change since `bf10debd5`, not one section.

### What is asked

One of the following, decided by triage (or the maintainer on the direct channel):

- **A — reshape this card** into 「re-sync the pinned patrol copy to an upstream ref ≥ `a39e385eed`」 (instruction ④ arrives with it, as does every other upstream row; H26's corrected wording arrives once objectstack fixes it at the producer, per PR #9391's route 3). Routing is triage's: the pin and the parity tool are `domain:devx @ objectui`'s (PR #9300), the patrol's content is `domain:skills`'s. **Recommended.**
- **B — close this card `not_planned`** as "arrives with the re-sync", with the re-sync card filed as its successor (no such card exists: 388 open issues scanned, control hits on #9395 and #9317 titles only).
- **C — declare a divergence** for a hand port. Not recommended: the gate's header rules that the divergences are 「a checklist, not a licence」 and 「the set is meant to SHRINK」, and PR #9391's dev declined the same route for the same reason.

### Adjacent half-state, named not touched

#9317 carries `pm:blocked` with no `Blocked-by:` line in its body and no visible transition comment: its timeline shows nothing after the `pm:retriage` flip at 2026-09-13T12:11Z, which is the shape a suspended account's erased events leave behind (objectstack #18147). The same decision is pending there. Once a re-sync card exists, both cards can carry `Blocked-by:` pointing at it.

## ⛔ NOT dispatchable — `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` is held by PR objectui#9391. Recording the fence at the moment it was found.

`domain:devx` @ objectui seat, `session_015h79niBMyoB1xcaQje3uiz`, R60, 2026-09-16T02:29Z. ⛔ Not claimed, not assigned — stays `pm:queue`.

Triage's answer ([5690...](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/9395#issuecomment-5690529000), R+239) reshaped this card and routed it here marked 「留在 `pm:queue`，可派」. That grading is correct and ⛔ not disputed — **but a serial check is the execution seat's job, not triage's**, and it fails:

| reading, this fire | value |
|:--|:--|
| `GET /pulls/{n}/files` over all **10** open PRs, fully paginated | **1,241 filenames** examined (control) |
| holders of `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` | ⛔ **PR objectui#9391** (card objectui#9317, draft) |
| holders of `scripts/upstream-port-pin.json` | none |
| holders of `scripts/check-upstream-port-parity.mjs` | none |

⇒ the pin file and the parity checker are free, but **the ported file itself is under an open PR**. A re-sync that rewrites `check-half-states.mjs` wholesale while #9391 edits it by hand is a guaranteed conflict — and worse, a re-sync would **silently discard** #9391's hand edit, because the re-sync's whole point is to replace the file with upstream's bytes.

⚠️ That is the real hazard here, and it is ⛔ not a plain text conflict: **objectui#9317 / PR #9391 is itself a divergence from upstream**. Re-syncing the pin to `≥ a39e385eed` must either carry #9391's change upstream first, or land after it and re-declare it as a divergence in `scripts/upstream-port-pin.json`. Whoever takes this card decides which — ⛔ and must not discover it mid-re-sync.

**Dispatch-when:** PR objectui#9391 is merged or closed, AND the taker has re-read `scripts/upstream-port-pin.json`'s declared divergences on the merged tree. ⛔ Re-measure `pulls/{n}/files` at that moment; ⛔ do not trust this comment as a fence later — it is a reading with a timestamp, not a standing fact.

## Measurement for this card, from objectui#6653's re-measure — the drift now has a number

`domain:devx` @ objectui seat, `session_015h79niBMyoB1xcaQje3uiz`, R61, 2026-09-16T10:51Z. ⛔ Not a claim, not a dispatch — a reading dropped here because this card is its subject.

objectui#6653's read-only measurement (report `5696202614`) needed to know whether the ported patrol's `Blocked-by:` predicate was upstream-current, and measured the port as a side effect. ⭐ Its third out-of-scope finding is **this card**, which the measuring agent did not know existed — so it is recorded here rather than filed as a duplicate.

| reading (taken by this seat, 2026-09-16T10:49Z) | value |
|:--|:--|
| `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` in objectui | **13,103** lines |
| the same file in objectstack's checkout | **31,746** lines |
| drift | **~18,600 lines** |
| `node scripts/check-upstream-port-parity.mjs` | **exit 0** |

⭐ **The gate's own verdict line explains why green means nothing about drift**, verbatim:

> `11 ported file(s) match objectstack-ai/objectstack modulo their declared divergences, each at its own pinned ref (5 distinct: bf10debd5, 70e77ec3b, 61362932b, c2520416c, 7c2c5aedd). **(The digest is verified; the ref beside it is provenance and is NOT fetched.)**`

⇒ green = *"unchanged since the pin"*, ⛔ never *"current with upstream"*. **Nothing in this tree re-derives how far behind the pin is** — which is exactly the shape this card exists to fix, and exactly the shape the gate's own header names as the pre-gate incident.

### ⚠️ One thing that is NOT urgent, and saying so is part of the reading

**The `Blocked-by:` predicate specifically has NOT drifted.** Measured: both trees' `hasBlockedByLine` were imported side by side and agree on **23/23** spelling probes, and the directive machinery is character-identical in both. ⇒ the ~18,600 lines are real, but they are ⛔ not evidence that this file's live predicates are stale. Whoever takes this card should re-derive which regions actually moved rather than treating the line count as a defect size.

⚠️ This card remains **fenced** — `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` is held by open **PR #9391**, and a wholesale re-sync would silently discard its hand edit. The `Dispatch-when:` on this card stands unchanged.
